title: christella assamica
intro: Christella assamica, commonly known as the Assam fern or Christella, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Christella assamica include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
